purpose: Judge Cells' own physics (resolved_pump_tissue@1, physical route, D131) on BETSE's default world against the plain-BETSE case betse-reference-20261108-01/default-world-dense. Fixed and committed before the judged runs; each run's comparison manifest must name this file's sha256.

tolerance_derivation.method: tolerance = 3 x (sum of measured difference terms + X_ext), rounded up to one significant figure; method pinned before any judged run in default-world-parity-20261108-01/physical_route_observables.txt. A failure is a finding to attribute with the emulator variants, never a reason to retune.

betse_10ms_init_step.source: emulator difference budget (dt vs dt/100) and plain BETSE dense vs fine (127 uV at 0.34 s)

constants_codata_vs_betse.source: emulator difference budget and scout probe

conservative_compact_ecm_stencil.source: scout probe (4.2e-4 includes its dt part, kept as an upper value)

X_ext_within_cell_patch_voltage_spread.source: blind Cells-only runs, default-world-parity-20261108-01/blind-02/summary.json (INIT 0.438 uV, SIM 0.437 uV); cells_rel scaled from the constants term per uV

tolerance_derivation.cells_numerics: ARS(2,2,2): 13 nV at 1 ms, negligible at 0.1 ms

observable_mapping: BETSE vm in this world is cell charge / (cm * sum mem_sa), uniform within a cell (Phi_b = 0; v_env not subtracted; sim.py:2029). Cells vm_ave = Q_cell / sum C_patch with C_patch = cm * mem_sa, broadcast to membranes for vm. Patch voltages and exterior potentials are diag_* arrays, reported only. Boundary-ring ECM sites are excluded: BETSE resets them each step, the resolved model holds them as reservoirs.
notes: Reported only: venv_time (BETSE's screened, smoothed estimate has no Cells counterpart) and Cells diag_* arrays.
Gate open fraction is not in the comparison layout and is not judged.
